description: This file is a Go source code defining a package 'randfill' that provides functionality to populate Go objects with random data, including the implementation of a 'Filler' struct with methods for customization, recursive filling, and support for custom fill functions and unicode string generation.

classes.name: Filler
classes.description: A struct that provides methods to fill Go objects with random data, supporting customization, recursion, and thread safety.

classes.name: Continue
classes.description: A helper struct that provides methods for custom fill functions to continue filling objects with access to the same randomness source.

classes.name: fillerContext
classes.description: A context struct used internally to manage recursive filling and thread safety during the fill process.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Filler instance with a seed based on current time.

methods.name: NewWithSeed
methods.description: Creates a new Filler with a specified seed for deterministic randomness.

methods.name: NewFromGoFuzz
methods.description: Creates a Filler configured to work with go-fuzz for fuzz testing, using provided byte slice as source.

methods.name: Funcs
methods.description: Registers custom fill functions for specific types.

methods.name: RandSource
methods.description: Sets the source of randomness for deterministic behavior.

methods.name: NilChance
methods.description: Sets the probability of generating nil pointers, maps, or slices.

methods.name: NumElements
methods.description: Sets the min and max number of elements for slices and maps.

methods.name: MaxDepth
methods.description: Sets the maximum recursion depth for filling objects.

methods.name: AllowUnexportedFields
methods.description: Configures whether unexported fields can be filled.

methods.name: SkipFieldsWithPattern
methods.description: Adds patterns to skip certain fields during filling.

methods.name: Fill
methods.description: Recursively fills the provided object with random data, using custom functions and support for complex types.

methods.name: FillNoCustom
methods.description: Fills the object without invoking custom fill functions.
